in_marathi.name: Mehul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mehul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mehul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohan', which means 'moon'. The name signifies the shining moon and is often given to boys born during the lunar phase. It is a popular name in Hindu culture.
